== decoy
local record Decoy
  record Pile
    add: function(Pile, integer): integer
  end
  pile: function(): Pile
end
function Decoy.pile(): Decoy.Pile
  return { add = function(_: Decoy.Pile, n: integer): integer return n end }
end
return Decoy
== tally
local record Tally
  count: integer
  add: function(Tally, integer): integer
  bump: function(Tally)
  new: function(): Tally
end
local function add(self: Tally, n: integer): integer
  self:bump()
  return self.count + n
end
local function bump(self: Tally)
  self.count = self.count + 1
end
function Tally.new(): Tally
  return { count = 0, add = add, bump = bump }
end
return Tally
== told
local interface Told
  tell: function(Told): string
end
local record Teller is Told
  n: integer
  new: function(): Teller
end
function Teller.new(): Teller
  return { n = 1, tell = function(_: Teller): string return 't' end }
end
return Teller
== zipx
local record Zipx
  interface Collector
    write: function(Collector, string): boolean, string
  end
  record Writer is Collector
    name: string
    write: function(Writer, string): boolean, string
    close: function(Writer): boolean, string
  end
  record Plain
    size: integer
    grow: function(Plain): integer
  end
  interface Base
    tell: function(Base): string
  end
  interface Mid is Base
    tell: function(Mid): string
  end
  record Deep is Mid
    tell: function(Deep): string
  end
  open: function(): Writer
  plain: function(): Plain
  deep: function(): Deep
end
local record Private
  secret: integer
end
local function secret(): Private return { secret = 1 } end
function Zipx.open(): Zipx.Writer
  local p = secret()
  return {
    name = 'w' .. tostring(p.secret),
    write = function(_: Zipx.Writer, _s: string): boolean, string return true, '' end,
    close = function(_: Zipx.Writer): boolean, string return true, '' end,
  }
end
function Zipx.deep(): Zipx.Deep
  return { tell = function(_: Zipx.Deep): string return 'd' end }
end
function Zipx.plain(): Zipx.Plain
  return { size = 1, grow = function(p: Zipx.Plain): integer return p.size end }
end
return Zipx

  note: function(Note, integer | nil, string)
end

local record Options
  links: string
end
local function f(o: Options)
  if o.links == 'skip' then use(1) elseif o.links ~= 'create' then use(2) end
end
use(f)

== decoy
local record Decoy
  record Pile
    add: function(Pile, integer): integer
  end
  pile: function(): Pile
end
function Decoy.pile(): Decoy.Pile

== tally
local record Tally
  count: integer
  add: function(Tally, integer): integer
  bump: function(Tally)
  new: function(): Tally
end
local function add(self: Tally, n: integer): integer
  self:bump()
  return self.count + n
end
local function bump(self: Tally)
  self.count = self.count + 1
end
function Tally.new(): Tally
  return { count = 0, add = add, bump = bump }
end
return Tally
== told
local interface Told
  tell: function(Told): string
end
local record Teller is Told
  n: integer
  new: function(): Teller
end
function Teller.new(): Teller
  return { n = 1, tell = function(_: Teller): string return 't' end }
end
return Teller
== zipx
local record Zipx
  interface Collector
    write: function(Collector, string): boolean, string
  end
  record Writer is Collector
    name: string
    write: function(Writer, string): boolean, string
    close: function(Writer): boolean, string
  end
  record Plain
    size: integer
    grow: function(Plain): integer
  end
  interface Base
    tell: function(Base): string
  end
  interface Mid is Base
    tell: function(Mid): string
  end
  record Deep is Mid
    tell: function(Deep): string
  end
  open: function(): Writer
  plain: function(): Plain
  deep: function(): Deep
end
local record Private
  secret: integer
end
local function secret(): Private return { secret = 1 } end
function Zipx.open(): Zipx.Writer
  local p = secret()
  return {
    name = 'w' .. tostring(p.secret),
    write = function(_: Zipx.Writer, _s: string): boolean, string return true, '' end,
    close = function(_: Zipx.Writer): boolean, string return true, '' end,
  }
end
function Zipx.deep(): Zipx.Deep
  return { tell = function(_: Zipx.Deep): string return 'd' end }
end
function Zipx.plain(): Zipx.Plain
  return { size = 1, grow = function(p: Zipx.Plain): integer return p.size end }
end
return Zipx

local record Decoy
  record Pile
    add: function(Pile, integer): integer
  end
  pile: function(): Pile
end
function Decoy.pile(): Decoy.Pile
  return { add = function(_: Decoy.Pile, n: integer): integer return n end }
end
return Decoy
== tally
local record Tally
  count: integer
  add: function(Tally, integer): integer
  bump: function(Tally)
  new: function(): Tally
end
local function add(self: Tally, n: integer): integer
  self:bump()
  return self.count + n
end
local function bump(self: Tally)
  self.count = self.count + 1
end
function Tally.new(): Tally
  return { count = 0, add = add, bump = bump }
end
return Tally
== told
local interface Told
  tell: function(Told): string
end
local record Teller is Told
  n: integer
  new: function(): Teller
end
function Teller.new(): Teller
  return { n = 1, tell = function(_: Teller): string return 't' end }
end
return Teller
== zipx
local record Zipx
  interface Collector
    write: function(Collector, string): boolean, string
  end
  record Writer is Collector
    name: string
    write: function(Writer, string): boolean, string
    close: function(Writer): boolean, string
  end
  record Plain
    size: integer
    grow: function(Plain): integer
  end
  interface Base
    tell: function(Base): string
  end
  interface Mid is Base
    tell: function(Mid): string
  end
  record Deep is Mid
    tell: function(Deep): string
  end
  open: function(): Writer
  plain: function(): Plain
  deep: function(): Deep
end
local record Private
  secret: integer
end
local function secret(): Private return { secret = 1 } end
function Zipx.open(): Zipx.Writer
  local p = secret()
  return {
    name = 'w' .. tostring(p.secret),
    write = function(_: Zipx.Writer, _s: string): boolean, string return true, '' end,
    close = function(_: Zipx.Writer): boolean, string return true, '' end,
  }
end
function Zipx.deep(): Zipx.Deep
  return { tell = function(_: Zipx.Deep): string return 'd' end }
end
function Zipx.plain(): Zipx.Plain
  return { size = 1, grow = function(p: Zipx.Plain): integer return p.size end }
end
return Zipx

end

  links: string
end
local function f(o: Options)
  local m = o.links
  if m == 'skip' then use(1) end
end
local function g(m: string)
  if m == 'a' or m == 'b' then use(2) end
end
use(f, g)

== decoy
local record Decoy
  record Pile
    add: function(Pile, integer): integer
  end
  pile: function(): Pile
end
function Decoy.pile(): Decoy.Pile
  return { add = function(_: Decoy.Pile, n: integer): integer return n end }
end
return Decoy
== tally
local record Tally
  count: integer
  add: function(Tally, integer): integer
  bump: function(Tally)
  new: function(): Tally
end
local function add(self: Tally, n: integer): integer
  self:bump()
  return self.count + n
end
local function bump(self: Tally)
  self.count = self.count + 1
end
function Tally.new(): Tally
  return { count = 0, add = add, bump = bump }
end
return Tally
== told
local interface Told
  tell: function(Told): string
end
local record Teller is Told
  n: integer
  new: function(): Teller
end
function Teller.new(): Teller
  return { n = 1, tell = function(_: Teller): string return 't' end }
end
return Teller
== zipx
local record Zipx
  interface Collector
    write: function(Collector, string): boolean, string
  end
  record Writer is Collector
    name: string
    write: function(Writer, string): boolean, string
    close: function(Writer): boolean, string
  end
  record Plain
    size: integer
    grow: function(Plain): integer
  end
  interface Base
    tell: function(Base): string
  end
  interface Mid is Base
    tell: function(Mid): string
  end
  record Deep is Mid
    tell: function(Deep): string
  end
  open: function(): Writer
  plain: function(): Plain
  deep: function(): Deep
end
local record Private
  secret: integer
end
local function secret(): Private return { secret = 1 } end
function Zipx.open(): Zipx.Writer
  local p = secret()
  return {
    name = 'w' .. tostring(p.secret),
    write = function(_: Zipx.Writer, _s: string): boolean, string return true, '' end,
    close = function(_: Zipx.Writer): boolean, string return true, '' end,
  }
end
function Zipx.deep(): Zipx.Deep
  return { tell = function(_: Zipx.Deep): string return 'd' end }
end
function Zipx.plain(): Zipx.Plain
  return { size = 1, grow = function(p: Zipx.Plain): integer return p.size end }
end
return Zipx

== decoy
local record Decoy
  record Pile
    add: function(Pile, integer): integer
  end
  pile: function(): Pile
end
function Decoy.pile(): Decoy.Pile
  return { add = function(_: Decoy.Pile, n: integer): integer return n end }

== tally
local record Tally
  count: integer
  add: function(Tally, integer): integer
  bump: function(Tally)
  new: function(): Tally
end
local function add(self: Tally, n: integer): integer
  self:bump()
  return self.count + n
end
local function bump(self: Tally)
  self.count = self.count + 1
end
function Tally.new(): Tally
  return { count = 0, add = add, bump = bump }
end
return Tally
== told
local interface Told
  tell: function(Told): string
end
local record Teller is Told
  n: integer
  new: function(): Teller
end
function Teller.new(): Teller
  return { n = 1, tell = function(_: Teller): string return 't' end }
end
return Teller
== zipx
local record Zipx
  interface Collector
    write: function(Collector, string): boolean, string
  end
  record Writer is Collector
    name: string
    write: function(Writer, string): boolean, string
    close: function(Writer): boolean, string
  end
  record Plain
    size: integer
    grow: function(Plain): integer
  end
  interface Base
    tell: function(Base): string
  end
  interface Mid is Base
    tell: function(Mid): string
  end
  record Deep is Mid
    tell: function(Deep): string
  end
  open: function(): Writer
  plain: function(): Plain
  deep: function(): Deep
end
local record Private
  secret: integer
end
local function secret(): Private return { secret = 1 } end
function Zipx.open(): Zipx.Writer
  local p = secret()
  return {
    name = 'w' .. tostring(p.secret),
    write = function(_: Zipx.Writer, _s: string): boolean, string return true, '' end,
    close = function(_: Zipx.Writer): boolean, string return true, '' end,
  }
end
function Zipx.deep(): Zipx.Deep
  return { tell = function(_: Zipx.Deep): string return 'd' end }
end
function Zipx.plain(): Zipx.Plain
  return { size = 1, grow = function(p: Zipx.Plain): integer return p.size end }
end
return Zipx

local record Tally
  count: integer
  add: function(Tally, integer): integer
  bump: function(Tally)
  new: function(): Tally
end
local function add(self: Tally, n: integer): integer
  self:bump()
  return self.count + n
end
local function bump(self: Tally)
  self.count = self.count + 1
end
function Tally.new(): Tally
  return { count = 0, add = add, bump = bump }
end
return Tally
== told
local interface Told
  tell: function(Told): string
end
local record Teller is Told
  n: integer
  new: function(): Teller
end
function Teller.new(): Teller
  return { n = 1, tell = function(_: Teller): string return 't' end }
end
return Teller
== zipx
local record Zipx
  interface Collector
    write: function(Collector, string): boolean, string
  end
  record Writer is Collector
    name: string
    write: function(Writer, string): boolean, string
    close: function(Writer): boolean, string
  end
  record Plain
    size: integer
    grow: function(Plain): integer
  end
  interface Base
    tell: function(Base): string
  end
  interface Mid is Base
    tell: function(Mid): string
  end
  record Deep is Mid
    tell: function(Deep): string
  end
  open: function(): Writer
  plain: function(): Plain
  deep: function(): Deep
end
local record Private
  secret: integer
end
local function secret(): Private return { secret = 1 } end
function Zipx.open(): Zipx.Writer
  local p = secret()
  return {
    name = 'w' .. tostring(p.secret),
    write = function(_: Zipx.Writer, _s: string): boolean, string return true, '' end,
    close = function(_: Zipx.Writer): boolean, string return true, '' end,
  }
end
function Zipx.deep(): Zipx.Deep
  return { tell = function(_: Zipx.Deep): string return 'd' end }
end
function Zipx.plain(): Zipx.Plain
  return { size = 1, grow = function(p: Zipx.Plain): integer return p.size end }
end
return Zipx

  interface Collector

  end
  record Writer is Collector
    name: string
    write: function(Writer, string): boolean, string
    close: function(Writer): boolean, string
  end
  record Plain
    size: integer
    grow: function(Plain): integer
  end
  interface Base
    tell: function(Base): string
  end
  interface Mid is Base
    tell: function(Mid): string
  end

    tell: function(Deep): string
  end

  deep: function(): Deep

  secret: integer
end

  local p = secret()
  return {
    name = 'w' .. tostring(p.secret),
    write = function(_: Zipx.Writer, _s: string): boolean, string return true, '' end,
    close = function(_: Zipx.Writer): boolean, string return true, '' end,
  }
end
function Zipx.deep(): Zipx.Deep
  return { tell = function(_: Zipx.Deep): string return 'd' end }
end
function Zipx.plain(): Zipx.Plain
  return { size = 1, grow = function(p: Zipx.Plain): integer return p.size end }

    say: function(Logger, string): boolean, string
    flush: function(Logger): boolean, string
  end
end
function Log.new(): Log.Logger
  return {
    say = function(_: Log.Logger, _line: string): boolean, string return true, '' end,
    flush = function(_: Log.Logger): boolean, string return true, '' end,
  }
end
return Log

  'skip'
  'create'
end
local record Options
  links: Links
end
local function f(o: Options)
  if o.links == 'skip' or o.links == 'create' then use(1) end
end
use(f)

  end

local function g(name: string)
  if name == 'store' then use(1) elseif name == 'deflate' then use(2) end
end

  g(o.method)

== decoy

    add: function(Pile, integer): integer
  end

== tally
local record Tally
  count: integer
  add: function(Tally, integer): integer
  bump: function(Tally)
  new: function(): Tally
end
local function add(self: Tally, n: integer): integer
  self:bump()
  return self.count + n
end
local function bump(self: Tally)
  self.count = self.count + 1
end
function Tally.new(): Tally
  return { count = 0, add = add, bump = bump }
end
return Tally
== told
local interface Told
  tell: function(Told): string
end
local record Teller is Told
  n: integer
  new: function(): Teller
end
function Teller.new(): Teller
  return { n = 1, tell = function(_: Teller): string return 't' end }
end
return Teller
== zipx
local record Zipx
  interface Collector
    write: function(Collector, string): boolean, string
  end
  record Writer is Collector
    name: string
    write: function(Writer, string): boolean, string
    close: function(Writer): boolean, string
  end
  record Plain
    size: integer
    grow: function(Plain): integer
  end
  interface Base
    tell: function(Base): string
  end
  interface Mid is Base
    tell: function(Mid): string
  end
  record Deep is Mid
    tell: function(Deep): string
  end
  open: function(): Writer
  plain: function(): Plain
  deep: function(): Deep
end
local record Private
  secret: integer
end
local function secret(): Private return { secret = 1 } end
function Zipx.open(): Zipx.Writer
  local p = secret()
  return {
    name = 'w' .. tostring(p.secret),
    write = function(_: Zipx.Writer, _s: string): boolean, string return true, '' end,
    close = function(_: Zipx.Writer): boolean, string return true, '' end,
  }
end
function Zipx.deep(): Zipx.Deep
  return { tell = function(_: Zipx.Deep): string return 'd' end }
end
function Zipx.plain(): Zipx.Plain
  return { size = 1, grow = function(p: Zipx.Plain): integer return p.size end }
end
return Zipx

== tally
local record Tally
  count: integer
  add: function(Tally, integer): integer
  bump: function(Tally)
  new: function(): Tally
end
local function add(self: Tally, n: integer): integer
  self:bump()
  return self.count + n
end
local function bump(self: Tally)
  self.count = self.count + 1
end
function Tally.new(): Tally
  return { count = 0, add = add, bump = bump }

== zipx
local record Zipx
  interface Collector
    write: function(Collector, string): boolean, string
  end
  record Writer is Collector
    name: string
    write: function(Writer, string): boolean, string
    close: function(Writer): boolean, string
  end
  record Plain
    size: integer
    grow: function(Plain): integer
  end
  interface Base
    tell: function(Base): string
  end
  interface Mid is Base
    tell: function(Mid): string
  end
  record Deep is Mid
    tell: function(Deep): string
  end
  open: function(): Writer
  plain: function(): Plain
  deep: function(): Deep
end
local record Private
  secret: integer
end
local function secret(): Private return { secret = 1 } end
function Zipx.open(): Zipx.Writer
  local p = secret()
  return {
    name = 'w' .. tostring(p.secret),
    write = function(_: Zipx.Writer, _s: string): boolean, string return true, '' end,
    close = function(_: Zipx.Writer): boolean, string return true, '' end,
  }
end
function Zipx.deep(): Zipx.Deep
  return { tell = function(_: Zipx.Deep): string return 'd' end }
end
function Zipx.plain(): Zipx.Plain
  return { size = 1, grow = function(p: Zipx.Plain): integer return p.size end }
end
return Zipx

  interface Collector
    write: function(Collector, string): boolean, string
  end
  record Writer is Collector
    name: string
    write: function(Writer, string): boolean, string
    close: function(Writer): boolean, string
  end
  record Plain
    size: integer
    grow: function(Plain): integer
  end
  interface Base
    tell: function(Base): string
  end
  interface Mid is Base
    tell: function(Mid): string
  end
  record Deep is Mid
    tell: function(Deep): string
  end
  open: function(): Writer
  plain: function(): Plain
  deep: function(): Deep
end

  secret: integer
end
local function secret(): Private return { secret = 1 } end
function Zipx.open(): Zipx.Writer
  local p = secret()
  return {
    name = 'w' .. tostring(p.secret),
    write = function(_: Zipx.Writer, _s: string): boolean, string return true, '' end,
    close = function(_: Zipx.Writer): boolean, string return true, '' end,
  }
end
function Zipx.deep(): Zipx.Deep
  return { tell = function(_: Zipx.Deep): string return 'd' end }
end

  return { size = 1, grow = function(p: Zipx.Plain): integer return p.size end }
end

end
